title: Thaumcraft Research File
description: JSON format for Thaumonomicon research entries. Ported from Thaumcraft 6 (1.12.2) ResearchManager.parseResearchJson. Each file holds the entries of one research category and is registered via ThaumcraftApi.registerResearchLocation. Root object contains a single 'entries' array.

key.description: REQUIRED. Unique key identifying this research (e.g. FIRSTSTEPS). Keys starting with '!' are internal flags granted by events/scanning, not full entries.

name.description: REQUIRED. Display name or localization key (e.g. research.FIRSTSTEPS.title).

category.description: REQUIRED. Category/tab key this entry belongs to (BASICS, ALCHEMY, AUROMANCY, ARTIFICE, INFUSION, GOLEMANCY, ELDRITCH). Must be registered via ResearchCategories.registerCategory.

icons.description: Icons cycled at 1s intervals. Each value is either an item stack string (see itemStack) or a texture path (e.g. arcaneresearch:textures/item/thaumonomicon.png). Values starting with 'focus' are treated as focus icon names.

parents.description: Parent research keys required before this entry unlocks. Suffix '@N' opens the entry at stage N of the parent instead of completion. Prefix '~' hides the connector line in the GUI.

siblings.description: Research keys auto-completed when this entry completes. Same '@'/'~' affixes as parents.

meta.description: Behavior flags. ROUND/HEX/SPIKY: icon frame (SPIKY grants +0.5 theorycraft inspiration). REVERSE: flip parent connector direction. HIDDEN: hidden until unlockable (+0.1 inspiration). AUTOUNLOCK: unlocked automatically once parents complete.

location.description: Grid position [column, row] of the icon in the category tab. Must not overlap another entry in the same category.

reward_item.description: Item stacks granted on completion. Item stack format, single quotes allowed for NBT.

reward_knowledge.description: Knowledge granted on completion. Format 'TYPE;CATEGORY;amount' (e.g. OBSERVATION;AUROMANCY;1). CATEGORY must be a registered category key.

stages.description: Ordered progression stages. A stage with no requirements auto-completes.

addenda.description: Bonus pages shown once the main research is complete plus the addendum trigger research.

text.description: REQUIRED. Localization key for the stage description text.

recipes.description: Recipe IDs shown on this page (ResourceLocation format, e.g. arcaneresearch:thaumometer).

required_item.description: Items the player must hand in. Item stack format, or 'tag:<namespace>:<path>' for a tag requirement (1.20 replacement for 1.12 'oredict:<name>').

required_craft.description: Items the player must craft (tracked via craftingReferences hash). Same value format as required_item.

required_knowledge.description: Knowledge costs consumed to pass this stage. Format 'TYPE;CATEGORY;amount', e.g. THEORY;GOLEMANCY;2.

required_research.description: Entries are 'KEY' or 'KEY;icon'. KEY may reference a full research entry or a virtual scan flag (shown as '?'/map/flask/chest glyph). An optional second segment overrides the displayed icon texture. Prefixes: 'm_' map, 'f_' flask, 'c_' chest, '!' hidden internal flag.

warp.description: Warp gained when completing this stage (split between PERMANENT and NORMAL).

text.description: REQUIRED. Localization key for the addendum page text.

recipes.description: Recipe IDs shown on this addendum page.

required_research.description: Research keys triggering this addendum once the parent entry is complete.

itemStack.description: Item stack string: 'modid:itemname', optionally ';count', optionally ';{nbt}'. Legacy 1.12 ';meta' segments are ignored. Resource names must be lowercase (1.20). Unresolvable names fall back to LEGACY_ITEM_MAPPINGS in ResearchManager (e.g. arcaneresearch:ingot -> arcaneresearch:thaumium_ingot, arcaneresearch:enchanted_placeholder -> minecraft:enchanted_book). NBT uses 1.20 format, e.g. {StoredEnchantments:[{id:'minecraft:silk_touch',lvl:1s}]}.
